description: Reviewed current-wire V1.50 ReactionA/B simulator Golden for the V2 F+29 scheduled-reset boundary, covering Superconduct and Overload.

provenance.note: The task ordering is pinned to a source-derived provisional policy. This fixture is not official server truth and does not claim complete gcsim scheduler, Aura, ICD, character, particle, or action-frame parity.

limitations.note: This reviewed Golden captures reset-before-attempt for Superconduct and Overload. The opposite hit-before-reset topology is captured separately by the recursive Shatter simulator regression, and both FIFO orders are also covered by ReactionDamageGroupTaskEngine unit tests.
